audit.whatIsWrong: Flagged defect: Yorick wins 58.8% here but the chart gave Kennen 4 of 7 stages and Yorick none, and difficulty read 8.5/10.
audit.why: The already-audited mirror settled Level 1 = Skill, Levels 4-5 = Yorick, First item = Kennen, 2+ items = Yorick. Those four rows are exactly where this side disagreed. Kennen's edge is levels 1-2 poke and his first-item window; Yorick's is Mourning Mist onward and the two-item side lane, which is also what the page's own late/spikes[3] prose says.
audit.corrected: win[0]/phases[0].side to Skill (5/10), win[3]/phases[3].side to Yorick (7/10), win[5]/phases[5].side to Kennen (3/10), win[6]/phases[6].side to Yorick (6/10); diffRating 8.5/10 to 6/10 with the two prose lines that quote it.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why said Trinity Force is your spike on a row that belongs to Kennen, and phases[3].why was generic lane-control boilerplate.
audit.why: Kennen's first-item spike (poke plus mark stacking) beats a one-item Yorick; Yorick's real levels-4-5 spike is Mourning Mist at 700 range with armour shred, which out-reaches nothing of Kennen's but does aim the swarm at him. Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s and needs help to win a 1v1.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[3].why and phases[5].why to those spikes, and whys[0], whys[3], whys[6] to match the corrected rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not a single cooldown anywhere (flagged defect), and the page never explains Mark of the Storm — the mechanic the whole matchup runs on.
audit.why: Three Marks of the Storm stun. Thundering Shuriken, Electrical Surge and Lightning Rush each apply one, so the counterplay is leaving after the second mark, not after the stun. Lightning Rush is 10s at rank 1 at 170 range; Thundering Shuriken is 950 range on 7s at rank 1; Slicing Maelstrom is 120s flat at 550 range. Electrical Surge also applies on-hit, so magic resist rather than armour decides an extended trade.
audit.corrected: Marks, all four cooldowns and the on-hit note into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, report[5].t and the itemization line.
